05-13-1588 is May 13, 1588.  
13 weeks + 7 days = 14 weeks = 98 days.  
Subtract 98 days from May 13, 1588.  
April has 30 days in 1588 (Gregorian).  

May 13 - 98 days:  
Back up 13 days to May 1.  
Back up 30 more days to April 1.  
Back up 55 more days (98 - 13 - 30 = 55).  
March has 31 days, so back 31 days to March 1.  
Remaining 24 days (55 - 31 = 24).  
February 1588 is a leap year (1588 divisible by 4 and 400 in Gregorian), so 29 days in Feb.  
Back 24 days from March 1: February 6 (since 29 days in Feb, Feb 29 → Feb 1 is 29 days, but we only need 24 days back from March 1: March 1 → Feb 25 is 5 days? Let's recalc carefully).  

Better: Count days backward from May 13:  
April 13 is 30 days earlier = April 13, 1588.  
March 13 is 31 days earlier = March 13, 1588.  
We need 98 days total:  
From May 13 to April 13 = 30 days.  
From April 13 to March 13 = 31 days (total 61 days).  
From March 13 to Feb 13 = 29 days (leap year) (total 90 days).  
Need 8 more days back from Feb 13: Feb 13 → Feb 5 (13 - 8 = 5).  

Check: 30+31+29+8 = 98 days.  
So new date = February 5, 1588.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1588-02-05
